verses.geez:
ወመጽኡ ፡ መላእክቲሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሌዊ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እልዐዛር ፡ ካህን ፡ ወኀበ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ነዌ ፡ ወኀበ ፡
                  መላእክተ ፡ ነገደ ፡ አብያተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ለሕዝበ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And the heads of the families of the sons of Levi drew near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Naue, and to the heads of families of the tribes of Israel.

translations.lxx: And the heads of the families of the sons of Levi drew near to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Naue, and to the heads of families of the tribes of Israel.
translations.kjv: Then came near the heads of the fathers of the Levites unto Eleazar the priest, and unto Joshua the son of Nun, and unto the heads of the fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel;
translations.ron: Căpeteniile familiilor Leviţilor au venit la Eleazar preotul şi către Iosua, fiul lui Navi, şi la căpeteniile seminţiilor fiilor lui Israel,
translations.grk: Καὶ προσήλθοσαν οἱ ἀρχιπατριῶται τῶν υἱῶν Λευὶ πρὸς Ἐλεάζαρ τὸν ἱερέα, καὶ Ἰησοῦν τὸν τοῦ Ναυῆ, καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἀρχιφύλους πατριῶν ἐκ τῶν φυλῶν Ἰσραήλ·

verses.geez:
ወይቤልዎሙ ፡ በሴሎ ፡ በምድረ ፡ ከናኦን ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብሉ ፡ አዘዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በእደ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ከመ ፡ የሀበነ ፡
                  አህጉረ ፡ ዘውስቴቶን ፡ ንነብር ፡ ወፂኦታቲሆን ፡ ለእንስሳነ ።
verses.translation: And they spoke to them in Selo in the land of Chanaan, saying, The Lord gave commandment by Moses to give us cities to dwell in, and the country round about for our cattle.

translations.lxx: And they spoke to them in Selo in the land of Chanaan, saying, The Lord gave commandment by Moses to give us cities to dwell in, and the country round about for our cattle.
translations.kjv: And they spake unto them at Shiloh in the land of Canaan, saying, The LORD commanded by the hand of Moses to give us cities to dwell in, with the suburbs thereof for our cattle.
translations.ron: Şi au vorbit cu ei în Şilo, în pământul Canaanului şi au zis: "Domnul a poruncit prin Moise să ni se dea cetăţi pentru locuit şi împrejurimile lor pentru vitele noastre".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπον πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἐν Σηλὼ ἐν γῇ Χαναὰν, λέγοντες, ἐνετείλατο Κύριος ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ δοῦναι ἡμῖν πόλεις κατοικεῖν, καὶ τὰ περισπόρια τοῖς κτήνεσιν ἡμῶν.

verses.geez: ወወሀብዎሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ በትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እላንተ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ወፂኦታቲሆን ።
verses.translation: So the children of Israel gave to the Levites in their inheritance by the command of the Lord the cities and the country round.

translations.lxx: So the children of Israel gave to the Levites in their inheritance by the command of the Lord the cities and the country round.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel gave unto the Levites out of their inheritance, at the commandment of the LORD, these cities and their suburbs.
translations.ron: Şi au dat fiii lui Israel Leviţilor din părţile lor, după porunca Domnului, următoarele cetăţi cu împrejurimile lor:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ τοῖς Λευίταις ἐν τῷ κατακληρονομεῖν διὰ προστάγματος Κυρίου τὰς πόλεις καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῶν.

verses.geez:
ወበጽሖሙ ፡ መክፈልቶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ቃዓት ፤ ወኮነ ፡ ለካህናት ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወለሌዋውያን ፡ እምነ ፡
                  ሕዝበ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ስምዖን ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ብንያሚ ፡ መክፈልቶሙ ፡ ዐሠርቱ ፡ ወሠለስቱ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: And the lot came out for the children of Caath; and the sons of Aaron, the priests the Levites, had by lot thirteen cities out of the tribe of Juda, and out of the tribe of Symeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.

translations.lxx: And the lot came out for the children of Caath; and the sons of Aaron, the priests the Levites, had by lot thirteen cities out of the tribe of Juda, and out of the tribe of Symeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin.
translations.kjv: And the lot came out for the families of the Kohathites: and the children of Aaron the priest, which were of the Levites, had by lot out of the tribe of Judah, and out of the tribe of Simeon, and out of the tribe of Benjamin, thirteen cities.
translations.ron: Şi s-au tras sorţi pentru familia lui Cahat şi Leviţii, fiii lui Aaron preotul, au primit prin sorţi treisprezece cetăţi din seminţia lui Iuda şi din seminţia lui Simeon şi din seminţia lui Veniamin.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ κλῆρος τῷ δήμῳ Καάθ· καὶ ἐγένετο τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἀαρὼν τοῖς ἱερεῦσι τοῖς Λευίταις ἀπὸ φυλῆς Ἰούδα καὶ ἀπὸ φυλῆς Συμεὼν καὶ ἀπὸ φυλῆς Βενιαμὶν κληρωτὶ, πόλεις δεκατρεῖς.

verses.geez:
ወለደቂቀ ፡ ቃዓት ፡ እለ ፡ ተርፉ ፡ እምውስተ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ዳን ፡ ወእምነ ፡ መንፈቀ ፡
                  ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ መክፈልቶሙ ፡ ዐሠርቱ ፡ (ወሠለስቱ ፡) አህጉር ።
verses.translation: And to the sons of Caath that were left were given by lot ten cities, out of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasse.

translations.lxx: And to the sons of Caath that were left were given by lot ten cities, out of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasse.
translations.kjv: And the rest of the children of Kohath had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Ephraim, and out of the tribe of Dan, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh, ten cities.
translations.ron: Iar celorlalţi fii ai lui Cahat le-au căzut la sorţi zece cetăţi din familiile seminţiei lui Efraim şi din seminţia lui Dan şi de la jumătate din seminţia lui Manase.
translations.grk: Καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Καὰθ τοῖς καταλελειμμένοις ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ἐφραὶμ καὶ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Δὰν καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασσῆ κληρωτὶ, πόλεις δέκα.

verses.geez:
ወለደቂቀ ፡ ጌድሶን ፡ እምነ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ይሳኮር ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ አሴር ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ንፍታሌም ፡
                  ወእምነ ፡ መንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ በባሳን ፡ መክፈልቶሙ ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወሠላስ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Gedson had thirteen cities, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Aser, and out of the tribe of Nephthali, and out of the half tribe of Manasse in Basan.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Gedson had thirteen cities, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Aser, and out of the tribe of Nephthali, and out of the half tribe of Manasse in Basan.
translations.kjv: And the children of Gershon had by lot out of the families of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the half tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
translations.ron: Fiilor lui Gherşon li s-au cuvenit prin sorţi treisprezece cetăţi de la familiile seminţiei lui Isahar şi de la seminţia lui Aşer şi de la seminţia lui Neftali şi de la jumătate din seminţia lui Manase, în Vasan.
translations.grk: Καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Γεδσὼν ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς Ἰσσάχαρ καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς Ἀσὴρ καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς Νεφθαλὶ καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασσῆ ἐν τῇ Βασὰν, πόλεις δεκατρεῖς.

verses.geez:
ወለደቂቀ ፡ ሜራሪ ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ነገደ ፡
                  ዛቡሎን ፡ መክፈልቶሙ ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወክልኤ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: And the sons of Merari according to their families had by lot twelve cities, out of the tribe of Ruben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zabulon.

translations.lxx: And the sons of Merari according to their families had by lot twelve cities, out of the tribe of Ruben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zabulon.
translations.kjv: The children of Merari by their families had out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
translations.ron: Iar fiilor lui Merari, după familiile lor, le-au căzut la sorţi douăsprezece cetăţi din seminţia lui Ruben şi din seminţia lui Gad şi din seminţia lui Zabulon.
translations.grk: Καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Μεραρὶ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν ἀπὸ φυλῆς Ῥουβὴν καὶ ἀπὸ φυλῆς Γὰδ καὶ ἀπὸ φυλῆς Ζαβουλὼν κληρωτὶ, πόλεις δώδεκα.

verses.geez:
ወወሀብዎሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኤህጉረ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ ወፂኦታቲሆን ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡
                  መክፈልቶሙ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their suburbs, as the Lord commanded Moses, by lot.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities and their suburbs, as the Lord commanded Moses, by lot.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel gave by lot unto the Levites these cities with their suburbs, as the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses.
translations.ron: Şi au dat fiii lui Israel cetăţile acestea cu împrejurimile lor prin sorţi, cum poruncise Domnul prin Moise.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ τοῖς Λευίταις τὰς πόλεις καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῶν, ὃν τρόπον ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ, κληρωτί.

verses.geez:
ወወሀበ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡ ወነገደ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ስምዖን ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ብንያሚ ፡ እላንተ ፡
                  አህጉረ ፡ ወተሰምያ ፤
verses.translation: And the tribe of the children of Juda, and the tribe of the children of Symeon, and part of the tribe of the children of Benjamin gave these cities, and they were assigned

translations.lxx: And the tribe of the children of Juda, and the tribe of the children of Symeon, and part of the tribe of the children of Benjamin gave these cities, and they were assigned
translations.kjv: And they gave out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, these cities which are here mentioned by name,
translations.ron: Din seminţia fiilor lui Iuda şi din seminţia fiilor lui Veniamin şi din seminţia fiilor lui Simeon au dat cetăţile următoare, care se numesc pe nume:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκεν ἡ φυλὴ υἱῶν Ἰούδα καὶ ἡ φυλὴ υἱῶν Συμεὼν καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς υἱῶν Βενιαμὶν τὰς πόλεις ταύτας· καὶ ἐπεκλήθησαν

verses.geez: ለደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ እምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ቃዓት ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ሌዊ ፡ እስመ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ኮና ፡ መክፈልቶሙ ።
verses.translation: to the sons of Aaron of the family of Caath of the sons of Levi, for the lot fell to these.

translations.lxx: to the sons of Aaron of the family of Caath of the sons of Levi, for the lot fell to these.
translations.kjv: Which the children of Aaron, being of the families of the Kohathites, who were of the children of Levi, had: for theirs was the first lot.
translations.ron: Fiilor lui Aaron din familia lui Cahat dintre fiii lui Levi, fiindcă sorţul lor a fost întâiul,
translations.grk: τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἀαρὼν ἀπὸ τοῦ δήμου τοῦ Καὰθ τῶν υἱῶν Λευὶ, ὅτι τούτοις ἐγενήθη ὁ κλῆρος.

verses.geez:
ወወሀብዎሙ ፡ ምድረ ፡ ቀራትርቦቅ ፡ ደብረ ፡ አህጉረ ፡ ኤነቅ ፡ እንተ ፡ ይእቲ ፡ ኬብሮን ፡ በደብረ ፡ ይሁዳ ፡
                  ወፂኦታቲሃ ፡ ዐውዳ ።
verses.translation: And they gave to them Cariatharboc the metropolis of the sons of Enac; this is Chebron in the mountain country of Juda, and the suburbs round it.

translations.lxx: And they gave to them Cariatharboc the metropolis of the sons of Enac; this is Chebron in the mountain country of Juda, and the suburbs round it.
translations.kjv: And they gave them the city of Arba the father of Anak, which city is Hebron, in the hill country of Judah, with the suburbs thereof round about it.
translations.ron: Li s-a dat: Chiriat-Arba, a tatălui lui Enac, sau Hebronul, în munţii lui Iuda şi locurile dimprejurul ei;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς τὴν Καριαθαρβὸκ μητρόπολιν τῶν Ἐνάκ· αὕτη ἐστὶ Χεβρὼν ἐν τῷ ὄρει Ἰούδα· τὰ δὲ περισπόρια κύκλῳ αὐτῆς,

verses.geez: ወአሕቅልተ ፡ ሀገር ፡ ወአዕጻዳቲሃ ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ ካሌብ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዬፎኔ ፡ ደወሎሙ ።
verses.translation: But the lands of the city, and its villages Joshua gave to the sons of Chaleb the son of Jephonne for a possession.

translations.lxx: But the lands of the city, and its villages Joshua gave to the sons of Chaleb the son of Jephonne for a possession.
translations.kjv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, gave they to Caleb the son of Jephunneh for his possession.
translations.ron: Iar ţarina cetăţii acesteia şi satele ei s-au dat ca moşie lui Caleb, fiul lui Iefone.
translations.grk: καὶ τοὺς ἀγροὺς τῆς πόλεως, καὶ τὰς κώμας αὐτῆς ἔδωκεν Ἰησοῦς τοῖς υἱοῖς Χάλεβ υἱοῦ Ἰεφοννὴ ἐν κατασχέσει.

verses.geez:
ወለደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ ወሀቦሙ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ምስካይ ፡ ለቀታሊ ፡ ኬብሮን ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወሌምና ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡
                  ምስሌሃ ።
verses.translation: And to the sons of Aaron he gave the city of refuge for the slayer, Chebron, and the suburbs belonging to it; and Lemna and the suburbs belonging to it;

translations.lxx: And to the sons of Aaron he gave the city of refuge for the slayer, Chebron, and the suburbs belonging to it; and Lemna and the suburbs belonging to it;
translations.kjv: Thus they gave to the children of Aaron the priest Hebron with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Libnah with her suburbs,
translations.ron: Şi astfel fiilor lui Aaron preotul li s-a dat cetatea cea de scăpare a ucigaşilor, Hebronul, şi împrejurimile ei, Libna şi împrejurimile ei.
translations.grk: Καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἀαρὼν ἔδωκε τὴν πόλιν φυγαδευτήριον τῷ φονεύσαντι, τὴν Χεβρὼν, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα τὰ σὺν αὐτῇ· καὶ τὴν Λεμνὰ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα τὰ πρὸς αὐτῇ·

verses.geez: ወኤሎም ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወጤማ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ።
verses.translation: and Ælom and its suburbs; and Tema and its suburbs;

translations.lxx: and Ælom and its suburbs; and Tema and its suburbs;
translations.kjv: And Jattir with her suburbs, and Eshtemoa with her suburbs,
translations.ron: Iatirul şi împrejurimile lui, Eştemoa şi împrejurimile ei;
translations.grk: Καὶ τὴν Αἰλὼμ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ τὴν Τεμὰ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ·

verses.geez: ወጌላ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወዳቢር ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ።
verses.translation: and Gella and its suburbs; and Dabir and its suburbs;

translations.lxx: and Gella and its suburbs; and Dabir and its suburbs;
translations.kjv: And Holon with her suburbs, and Debir with her suburbs,
translations.ron: Holonul şi împrejurimile lui, Debirul şi împrejurimile;
translations.grk: Καὶ τὴν Γελλὰ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ τὴν Δαβὶρ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ·

verses.geez:
[ወኣሳ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡] ወጣኒ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወ[ቤ]ትሰሚስ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ትስዑ ፡
                  አህጉር ፡ (ወ)እምነ ፡ ክልኤቱ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ እሉ ፡ ነገድ ።
verses.translation: and Asa and its suburbs; and Tany and its suburbs; and Bæthsamys and its suburbs: nine cities from these two tribes.

translations.lxx: and Asa and its suburbs; and Tany and its suburbs; and Bæthsamys and its suburbs: nine cities from these two tribes.
translations.kjv: And Ain with her suburbs, and Juttah with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs; nine cities out of those two tribes.
translations.ron: Ainul şi împrejurimile lui, Iuta şi împrejurimile ei, Bet-Semeşul şi împrejurimile lui: nouă cetăţi din aceste două seminţii.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ἀσὰ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ Τανὺ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ Βαιθσαμὺς, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· πόλεις ἐννέα παρὰ τῶν δύο φυλῶν τούτων.

verses.geez: ወእምነ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ብንያሚ ፡ ገባኦ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ [ወጋባ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ።
verses.translation: And from the tribe of Benjamin, Gabaon and its suburbs; and Gatheth and its suburbs;

translations.lxx: And from the tribe of Benjamin, Gabaon and its suburbs; and Gatheth and its suburbs;
translations.kjv: And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Gibeon with her suburbs, Geba with her suburbs,
translations.ron: Iar din seminţia lui Veniamin: Ghibeonul şi împrejurimile lui, Gheba cu împrejurimile ei,
translations.grk: Καὶ παρὰ τῆς φυλῆς Βενιαμὶν, τὴν Γαβαὼν, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ Γαθὲθ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ·

verses.geez: ወአናቶት ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወአልሞን ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡] አርባዕ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: and Anathoth and its suburbs; and Gamala and its suburbs; four cities.

translations.lxx: and Anathoth and its suburbs; and Gamala and its suburbs; four cities.
translations.kjv: Anathoth with her suburbs, and Almon with her suburbs; four cities.
translations.ron: Anatotul cu împrejurimile lui, Almonul cu împrejurimile lui: patru cetăţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ Ἀναθὼθ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ Γάμαλα, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· πόλεις τέσσαρες.

verses.geez: ወኵሎን ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ አሮን ፡ ካህናት ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወሠላስ ።
verses.translation: All the cities of the sons of Aaron the priests, thirteen.

translations.lxx: All the cities of the sons of Aaron the priests, thirteen.
translations.kjv: All the cities of the children of Aaron, the priests, were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
translations.ron: Cetăţile care au căzut la sorţi pentru preoţi, fiii lui Aaron, au fost toate treisprezece cu împrejurimile lor.
translations.grk: Πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις υἱῶν Ἀαρὼν τῶν ἱερέων, δεκατρεῖς.

verses.geez:
ወለነገደ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ቃዓት ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ እለ ፡ ተርፉ ፡ እምነ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ቃዓት ፤ ወኮነ ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ ፡
                  ለካህናቲሆሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ኤፍሬም ።
verses.translation: And to the families, even the sons of Caath the Levites, that were left of the sons of Caath, there was given their priests' city,

translations.lxx: And to the families, even the sons of Caath the Levites, that were left of the sons of Caath, there was given their priests' city,
translations.kjv: And the families of the children of Kohath, the Levites which remained of the children of Kohath, even they had the cities of their lot out of the tribe of Ephraim.
translations.ron: Iar celorlalţi din familiile fiilor lui Cahat, Leviţilor, le-a căzut la sorţi cetăţi în pământul lui Efraim.
translations.grk: Καὶ τοῖς δήμοις υἱοῖς Καὰθ τοῖς Λευίταις τοῖς καταλελειμμένοις ἀπὸ τῶν υἱῶν Καὰθ, καὶ ἐγενήθη ἡ πόλις τῶν ἱερέων αὐτῶν ἀπὸ φυλῆς Ἐφραίμ·

verses.geez: ወወሀቦሙ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ምስካይ ፡ ለቀታሊ ፡ ሲኬም ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ [ወጌዜር ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ።
verses.translation: out of the tribe of Ephraim; and they gave them the slayer's city of refuge, Sychem, and its suburbs, and Gazara and its appendages, and its suburbs;

translations.lxx: out of the tribe of Ephraim; and they gave them the slayer's city of refuge, Sychem, and its suburbs, and Gazara and its appendages, and its suburbs;
translations.kjv: For they gave them Shechem with her suburbs in mount Ephraim, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Gezer with her suburbs,
translations.ron: Şi li s-a dat cetatea de scăpare pentru ucigaşi, Sichemul cu împrejurimile lui în muntele lui Efraim, Ghezerul cu împrejurimile lui,
translations.grk: καὶ ἔδωκαν αὐτοῖς τὴν πόλιν τοῦ φυγαδευτηρίου τὴν τοῦ φονεύσαντος, τὴν Συχὲμ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ Γάζαρα καὶ τὰ πρὸς αὐτὴν, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ·

verses.geez: ወቄቤሳይን ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡] ወቤቶሮን ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ አርባዕ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: and Bæthoron and its suburbs: four cities:

translations.lxx: and Bæthoron and its suburbs: four cities:
translations.kjv: And Kibzaim with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs; four cities.
translations.ron: Chibţaimul cu împrejurimile lui, Bet-Horonul cu împrejurimile lui: patru cetăţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ Βαιθωρὼν, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα τὰ αὐτῇ· πόλεις τέσσαρες.

verses.geez:
ወእምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ዳን ፡ ኤልቆቴም ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ [ወገባቶን ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ።] ወኤሎን ፡ ወዘፈለጡ
                  ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወጌቴሬሞን ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ አርባዕ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: and of the tribe of Dan, Helcothaim and its suburbs; and Gethedan and its suburbs:

translations.lxx: and of the tribe of Dan, Helcothaim and its suburbs; and Gethedan and its suburbs:
translations.kjv: And out of the tribe of Dan, Eltekeh with her suburbs, Gibbethon with her suburbs,
translations.ron: Din seminţia lui Dan le-au căzut: Elteche şi împrejurimile lui, Ghibetonul şi împrejurimile lui;
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Δὰν, τὴν Ἑλκωθαὶμ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ τὴν Γεθεδὰν, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ·

verses.geez:
ወእምነ ፡ መንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ ጠናኅ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወዬቦታ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ አህጉር
                  ።
verses.translation: and Ælon and its suburbs; and Getheremmon and its suburbs: four cities.

translations.lxx: and Ælon and its suburbs; and Getheremmon and its suburbs: four cities.
translations.kjv: Aijalon with her suburbs, Gathrimmon with her suburbs; four cities.
translations.ron: Aialonul şi împrejurimile lui, Gat-Rimonul şi împrejurimile lui: patru cetăţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ Αἰλὼν, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ τὴν Γεθερεμμὼν, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· πόλεις τέσσαρες.

verses.geez: ወኵሉ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሆን ፡ ዘቅሩቦን ፡ ለነገደ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ቃዐት ፡ ለእለ ፡ ተርፉ ።
verses.translation: And out of the half tribe of Manasse, Tanach and its suburbs; and Jebatha and its suburbs; two cities.

translations.lxx: And out of the half tribe of Manasse, Tanach and its suburbs; and Jebatha and its suburbs; two cities.
translations.kjv: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh, Tanach with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs; two cities.
translations.ron: Din jumătatea seminţiei lui Manase: Taanacul şi împrejurimile lui, Gat-Rimonul şi împrejurimile lui: două cetăţi.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασσῆ, τὴν Τανὰχ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ τὴν Ἰεβαθὰ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· πόλεις δύο.

verses.geez:
ወለደቂቀ ፡ ጌድሶን ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ እምነ ፡ መንፈቀ ፡ ነገደ ፡ መናሴ ፡ አህጉር ፡ እለ ፡ ፈለጡ ፡ ለቀታሊ ፡ ገውሎን
                  ፡ በባሳን ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወቦሶር ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ክልኤ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: In all were given ten cities, and the suburbs of each belonging to them, to the families of the sons of Caath that remained.

translations.lxx: In all were given ten cities, and the suburbs of each belonging to them, to the families of the sons of Caath that remained.
translations.kjv: All the cities were ten with their suburbs for the families of the children of Kohath that remained.
translations.ron: Toate cetăţile cu împrejurimile lor căzute la sorţi celorlalţi fii ai lui Cahat au fost zece.
translations.grk: Πᾶσαι πόλεις δέκα, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ τὰ πρὸς αὐταῖς, τοῖς δήμοις υἱῶν Καὰθ τοῖς ὑπολελειμμένοις.

verses.geez: [ወእምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ይሳኮር ፡ ቄስዮን ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወዳቤራት ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ።
verses.translation: And Joshua gave to the sons of Gedson the Levites out of the other half tribe of Manasse cities set apart for the slayers, Gaulon in the country of Basan, and its suburbs; and Bosora and its suburbs; two cities.

translations.lxx: And Joshua gave to the sons of Gedson the Levites out of the other half tribe of Manasse cities set apart for the slayers, Gaulon in the country of Basan, and its suburbs; and Bosora and its suburbs; two cities.
translations.kjv: And unto the children of Gershon, of the families of the Levites, out of the other half tribe of Manasseh they gave Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Beeshterah with her suburbs; two cities.
translations.ron: Iar fiilor lui Gherşon din familiile Leviţilor li s-au dat: două cetăţi în Vasan, din jumătatea seminţiei lui Manase, şi anume: Golanul, cetatea de scăpare pentru ucigaşi, cu împrejurimile lui, şi Beştra cu împrejurimile ei;
translations.grk: Καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς Γεδσὼν τοῖς Λευίταις ἐκ τοῦ ἡμίσους φυλῆς Μανασσῆ τὰς πόλεις τὰς ἀφωρισμένας τοῖς φονεύσασι, τὴν Γαυλὼν ἐν τῇ Βασανίτιδι, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ τὴν Βοσορὰν, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· πόλεις δύο.

verses.geez:
ወያሬሞት ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወኤንጋን ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ አርባዕ ፡ አህጉር ።] ወእምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ አሴር ፡
                  በሴላ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወደቦ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ።
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kison and its suburbs; and Debba and its suburbs;

translations.lxx: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kison and its suburbs; and Debba and its suburbs;
translations.kjv: And out of the tribe of Issachar, Kishon with her suburbs, Dabareh with her suburbs,
translations.ron: Patru cetăţi în seminţia lui Isahar: Chişionul cu împrejurimile lui, Dabrat cu împrejurimile lui,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ἰσσάχαρ, τὴν Κισὼν, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ τὴν Δεββὰ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ·

verses.geez: ወኬልቀጥ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወራአብ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ አርባዕ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: and Remmath and its suburbs; and the well of Letters, and its suburbs; four cities.

translations.lxx: and Remmath and its suburbs; and the well of Letters, and its suburbs; four cities.
translations.kjv: Jarmuth with her suburbs, Engannim with her suburbs; four cities.
translations.ron: Iarmutul cu împrejurimile lui şi En-Ganimul cu împrejurimile lui;
translations.grk: Καὶ τὴν Ῥεμμὰθ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ Πηγὴν γραμμάτων, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· πόλεις τέσσαρες.

verses.geez:
ወእምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ንፍታሌም ፡ ሀገር ፡ እንተ ፡ ፈለጡ ፡ ለቀታሊ ፡ ጋዴስ ፡ በገሊላ ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወጴመት
                  ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወአዔሞን ፡ ወዘፈለጡ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ሠላስ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Aser, Basella and its suburbs; and Dabbon and its suburbs;

translations.lxx: And out of the tribe of Aser, Basella and its suburbs; and Dabbon and its suburbs;
translations.kjv: And out of the tribe of Asher, Mishal with her suburbs, Abdon with her suburbs,
translations.ron: Patru cetăţi în seminţia lui Aşer: Mişalul cu împrejurimile lui, Abdonul cu împrejurimile lui,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ἀσὴρ τὴν Βασελλὰν, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ τὴν Δαββὼν, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ·

verses.geez: ወኵሉ ፡ አህጉር ፡ ዘጌድሶን ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወሠላስ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: and Chelcat and its suburbs; and Raab and its suburbs; four cities.

translations.lxx: and Chelcat and its suburbs; and Raab and its suburbs; four cities.
translations.kjv: Helkath with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs; four cities.
translations.ron: Helcatul cu împrejurimile lui şi Rehobul cu împrejurimile lui;
translations.grk: Καὶ Χελκὰτ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ τὴν Ῥαὰβ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· πόλεις τέσσαρες.

verses.geez:
ወለነገደ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ሜራሪ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ተርፉ ፡ ሌዋውያን ፤ (ወ)እምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ዛቡሎን ፡ ማዐን ፡ ወፂኦታቲሃ ፡
                  ወቃዴስ ፡ ወፂኦታቲሃ ።
verses.translation: And of the tribe of Nephthali, the city set apart for the slayer, Cades in Galilee, and its suburbs; and Nemmath, and its suburbs; and Themmon and its suburbs; three cities.

translations.lxx: And of the tribe of Nephthali, the city set apart for the slayer, Cades in Galilee, and its suburbs; and Nemmath, and its suburbs; and Themmon and its suburbs; three cities.
translations.kjv: And out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Hammothdor with her suburbs, and Kartan with her suburbs; three cities.
translations.ron: Trei cetăţi din seminţia lui Neftali: Chedeşul Galileii, cetate pentru scăparea ucigaşilor, cu împrejurimile ei, Hamot-Dorul cu împrejurimile lui şi Cartanul cu împrejurimile lui.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Νεφθαλὶ, τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἀφωρισμένην τῷ φονεύσαντι, τὴν Κάδης ἐν τῇ Γαλιλαίᾳ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ τὴν Νεμμὰθ, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· καὶ Θεμμὼν, καὶ τὰ ἀφωρισμένα αὐτῇ· πόλεις τρεῖς.

verses.geez: ወሴላ ፡ ወፂኦታቲሃ ።
verses.translation: All the cities of Gedson according to their families were thirteen cities.

translations.lxx: All the cities of Gedson according to their families were thirteen cities.
translations.kjv: All the cities of the Gershonites according to their families were thirteen cities with their suburbs.
translations.ron: Toate cetăţile căzute la sorţi fiilor lui Gherşon, după familiile lor, au fost treisprezece cetăţi cu împrejurimile lor.
translations.grk: Πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις τοῦ Γεδσὼν κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν, πόλεις δεκατρεῖς.

verses.geez:
ወበማዕዶተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ዘመንገለ ፡ ኢየሪኮ ፡ እምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ሮቤል ፡ ሀገረ ፡ ምስካይ ፡ ለቀታሊ ፡ ቦሶር ፡
                  በገዳም ፡ ዘሚሶን ፡ ወፂኦታቲሃ ፡ ወያዜር ፡ ወፂኦታቲሃ ፡ ወጋዴዮን ፡ ወፂኦታቲሃ ፡ ወአውሳፋ ፡ ወፂኦታቲሃ ፡ አርባዕ ፡
                  አህጉር ።
verses.translation: And to the family of the sons of Merari the Levites that remained, he gave out of the tribe of Zabulon, Maan and its suburbs; and Cades and its suburbs,

translations.lxx: And to the family of the sons of Merari the Levites that remained, he gave out of the tribe of Zabulon, Maan and its suburbs; and Cades and its suburbs,
translations.kjv: And unto the families of the children of Merari, the rest of the Levites, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Jokneam with her suburbs, and Kartah with her suburbs,
translations.ron: Celorlalţi leviţi din fiii lui Merari li s-au dat patru cetăţi din seminţia lui Zabulon: Iocneamul cu împrejurimile lui,
translations.grk: Καὶ τῷ δήμῳ υἱῶν Μεραρὶ τοῖς Λευίταις τοῖς λοιποῖς ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ζαβουλὼν, τὴν Μαὰν, καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς· καὶ τὴν Κάδης, καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς·

verses.geez:
ወእምነ ፡ ሕዝበ ፡ ጋድ ፡ ሀገር ፡ ለምስካየ ፡ ቀታሊ ፡ ራሞት ፡ በገላአድ ፡ ወፂኦታቲሃ ፡ ወቃሚን ፡ ወፂኦታቲሃ ፡
                  ወ[ሔ]ሴቦን ፡ ወፂኦታቲሃ ፡ ወያዜር ፡ ወፂኦታቲሃ ፡ አርባዕ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: and Sella and its suburbs: three cities.

translations.lxx: and Sella and its suburbs: three cities.
translations.kjv: Dimnah with her suburbs, Nahalal with her suburbs; four cities.
translations.ron: Carta cu împrejurimile ei, Dimna cu împrejurimile ei şi Nahalalul cu împrejurimile lui;
translations.grk: Καὶ Σελλὰ, καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς· πόλεις τρεῖς.

verses.geez:
ወዘደቂቀ ፡ ሜራሪኒ ፡ በበ ፡ ሕዘቢሆሙ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ተርፉ ፡ እምነ ፡ ነገደ ፡ ሌዊ ፡ ወኮነ ፡
                  ደወሎሙ ፡ ዐሥሩ ፡ ወክልኤ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: And beyond Jordan over against Jericho, out of the tribe of Ruben, the city of refuge for the slayer, Bosor in the wilderness; Miso and its suburbs; and Jazer and its suburbs;

translations.lxx: And beyond Jordan over against Jericho, out of the tribe of Ruben, the city of refuge for the slayer, Bosor in the wilderness; Miso and its suburbs; and Jazer and its suburbs;
translations.kjv: And out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer with her suburbs, and Jahazah with her suburbs,
translations.ron: Patru cetăţi de cealaltă parte de Iordan, în faţa Ierihonului, în seminţia lui Ruben: Beţerul, cetate de scăpare pentru ucigaşi, cu împrejurimile lui, în pustiul Miso, Iahţa şi împrejurimile ei,
translations.grk: Καὶ πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου τοῦ κατὰ Ἰεριχὼ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ῥουβὴν, τὴν πόλιν τὸ φυγαδευτήριον τοῦ φονεύσαντος, τὴν Βοσὸρ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ· τὴν Μισὼ, καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς· καὶ τὴν Ἰαζὴρ, καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς·

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ ፡ አህጉሪሆሙ ፡ ለሌዋውያን ፡ በማእከለ ፡ ደወሎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ አርብዓ ፡ ወሰማኒ ፡ አህጉር ፡
                  ወፂኦታቲሆን ፡ ዘአውዶን ፡ ለእማንቱ ፡ አህጉር ።
verses.translation: and Decmon and its suburbs; and Mapha and its suburbs; four cities.

translations.lxx: and Decmon and its suburbs; and Mapha and its suburbs; four cities.
translations.kjv: Kedemoth with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs; four cities.
translations.ron: Chedemotul şi împrejurimile lui şi Mefaatul cu împrejurimile lui.
translations.grk: καὶ τὴν Δεκμὼν, καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς· καὶ τὴν Μαφὰ, καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς· πόλεις τέσσαρες.

verses.geez:
ለለ ፡ ሀገር ፡ ፂኦታቲሃ ፡ ዐውዳ ፡ ለሀገር ፡ ለኵሎን ፡ እላንቱ ፡ አህጉር ፤ ወፈጸመ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ከ[ፊለ] ፡ ምድር
                  ፡ በበ ፡ ደወሎሙ ።
verses.translation: And out of the tribe of Gad the city of refuge for the slayer, both Ramoth in Galaad, and its suburbs; Camin and its suburbs;

translations.lxx: And out of the tribe of Gad the city of refuge for the slayer, both Ramoth in Galaad, and its suburbs; Camin and its suburbs;
translations.kjv: And out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, to be a city of refuge for the slayer; and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
translations.ron: În seminţia lui Gad li s-au dat cetăţile de scăpare pentru ucigaşi: Ramot-Galaadul cu împrejurimile lui, Mahanaimul cu împrejurimile lui,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς Γὰδ, τὴν πόλιν τὸ φυγαδευτήριον τοῦ φονεύσαντος, καὶ τὴν Ῥαμὼθ ἐν τῇ Γαλαὰδ, καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς· τὴν Καμὶν, καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς·

verses.geez:
ወወሀብዎ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ክፍሎ ፡ ለኢየሱስ ፡ በትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወወሀብዎ ፡ ሀገረ ፡ እንተ ፡ ሰአለ ፡
                  ተምናሳረኅ ፡ ወወሀብዎ ፡ በደብረ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ወነደቃ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ሀገር ፡ ወነበረ ፡ ውስቴታ ።
verses.translation: and Esbon and its suburbs; and Jazer and its suburbs: the cities were four in all.

translations.lxx: and Esbon and its suburbs; and Jazer and its suburbs: the cities were four in all.
translations.kjv: Heshbon with her suburbs, Jazer with her suburbs; four cities in all.
translations.ron: Heşbonul cu împrejurimile lui şi Iazerul cu împrejurimile lui.
translations.grk: καὶ τὴν Ἐσβὼν, καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς· καὶ τὴν Ἰαζὴρ, καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῆς· πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις τέσσαρες.

verses.geez:
ወነሥአ ፡ ኢየሱስ ፡ ዝክተ ፡ መጣብኀ ፡ ዘእዝኅ ፡ ዘቦቱ ፡ ገዘሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለእለ ፡ ሀለዉ ፡ ምስሌሁ
                  ፡ ውስተ ፡ ፍኖት ፡ በገዳም ፡ እስመ ፡ ኢተገዝሩ ፡ በገዳም ፡ ወአንበሮን ፡ ውስተ ፡ ተምናሳረኅ ።
verses.translation: All these cities were given to the sons of Merari according to the families of them that were left out of the tribe of Levi; and their limits were the twelve cities.

translations.lxx: All these cities were given to the sons of Merari according to the families of them that were left out of the tribe of Levi; and their limits were the twelve cities.
translations.kjv: So all the cities for the children of Merari by their families, which were remaining of the families of the Levites, were by their lot twelve cities.
translations.ron: Cetăţile ieşite la sorţi pentru familiile de Leviţi din neamul lui Merari, după familiile lor, au fost douăsprezece.
translations.grk: Πᾶσαι αἱ πόλεις τοῖς υἱοῖς Μεραρὶ κατὰ δήμους αὐτῶν τῶν καταλελειμμένων ἀπὸ τῆς φυλῆς τῆς Λευί· καὶ ἐγενήθη τὰ ὅρια αἱ πόλεις δεκαδύο.

verses.geez:
ወወሀቦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ምድረ ፡ እንተ ፡ መሐለ ፡ ለአበዊሆሙ ፡ ወተወርስዋ ፡ ወነበሩ
                  ፡ ውስቴታ ።
verses.translation: All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the children of Israel, were forty-eight cities,

translations.lxx: All the cities of the Levites in the midst of the possession of the children of Israel, were forty-eight cities,
translations.kjv: All the cities of the Levites within the possession of the children of Israel were forty and eight cities with their suburbs.
translations.ron: Iar toate cetăţile date Leviţilor între fiii lui Israel au fost patruzeci şi opt de cetăţi cu împrejurimile lor. Fiecare din aceste cetăţi îşi avea împrejurimile ei de jur împrejur; aşa erau toate cetăţile acestea.
translations.grk: Πᾶσαι πόλεις τῶν Λευιτῶν ἐν μέσῳ κατασχέσεως υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, τεσσαρακονταοκτὼ πόλεις, καὶ τὰ περισπόρια αὐτῶν

verses.geez:
ወአዕረፎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ እምነ ፡ ዐውዶሙ ፡ በከመ ፡ መሐለ ፡ ለአበዊሆሙ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ እንከ ፡ መኑሂ ፡ ዘተቃወሞሙ
                  ፡ ቅድመ ፡ ገጾሙ ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ፀሮሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ አግብኦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኵሉ ፡ ፀሮሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሆሙ ።
verses.translation: and their suburbs round about these cities: a city and the suburbs round about the city to all these cities:

translations.lxx: and Joshua took the knives of stone, wherewith he circumcised the children of Israel that were born in the desert by the way, and put them in Thamnasachar.
translations.kjv: These cities were every one with their suburbs round about them: thus were all these cities.
translations.ron: După ce a sfârşit Iosua împărţirea ţării prin sorţi, fiii lui Israel au dat parte lui Iosua după porunca Domnului; şi i-au dat cetatea pe care a cerut-o el: Timnat-Serah, în muntele Efraim, şi a zidit Iosua cetatea pe care a cerut-o şi a locuit în ea. Şi a luat Iosua cuţitele cele de piatră, cele cu care tăiase împrejur pe fiii lui Israel, care se născuseră pe cale în pustiu, căci în pustiu nu fuseseră tăiaţi împrejur, şi le-a pus în Timnat-Serah.
translations.grk: κύκλῳ τῶν πόλεων τούτων· πόλις καὶ τὰ περισπόρια κύκλῳ τῆς πόλεως πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσι ταύταις· καὶ συνετέλεσεν Ἰησοῦς διαμερίσας τὴν γῆν ἐν τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτῶν· καὶ ἔδωκαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ἰσραὴλ μερίδα τῷ Ἰησοῖ διὰ πρόσταγμα Κυρίου· ἔδωκαν αὐτῷ τὴν πόλιν, ἣν ᾐτήσατο· τὴν Θαμνασαχὰρ ἔδωκαν αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Ἐφραίμ· καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν Ἰησοῦς τὴν πόλιν, καὶ ᾤκησεν ἐν αὐτῇ· καὶ ἔλαβεν Ἰησοῦς τὰς μαχαίρας τὰς πετρίνας, ἐν αἷς περιέτεμε τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ τοὺς γενομένους ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ, καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὰς ἐν Θαμνασαχάρ.

verses.geez:
ወኢተርፈት ፡ አሐቲ ፡ ቃል ፡ እምነ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ሠናይት ፡ እንተ ፡ ይቤሎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኵሉ
                  ፡ በጽሖሙ ።
verses.translation: So the Lord gave to Israel all the land which he sware to give to their fathers: and they inherited it, and dwelt in it.

translations.lxx: So the Lord gave to Israel all the land which he sware to give to their fathers: and they inherited it, and dwelt in it.
translations.kjv: And the LORD gave unto Israel all the land which he sware to give unto their fathers; and they possessed it, and dwelt therein.
translations.ron: Astfel a dat Domnul lui Israel toată ţara, pe care jurase să o dea părinţilor lor şi au primit-o ei moştenire şi s-au aşezat în ea.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἔδωκε Κύριος τῷ Ἰσραὴλ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν, ἣν ὤμοσε δοῦναι τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν· καὶ κατεκληρονόμησαν αὐτὴν, καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐν αὐτῇ.
